title: 第十五章 黄泉路上走慢点第十六章 李开先的复仇
lines: 真男人从不委屈自己，当有了报仇的能力，就不要犹豫，以最实用的手段干死对手。
修行不易，能怪别人的，就别怪自己。
龙门山广场瞬间大乱了，李晴川四周的弟子哗啦啦如潮水般退去，那些之前和李晴川关系比较好的弟子，退得最远，要和李晴川划清界限。
这就是所谓的利益朋友。
你辉煌的时候，他们伴其左右，任你使唤，你就是爷。
当你没落，那就是众矢之的，对你避之不及，躲得远远的算是有良心的，若有机会，他们第一个上来踩你几脚。
五六个执法堂弟子率先走了出来，要对李晴川动手。
“住手。”
李开先大喝一声，他睚眦欲裂，如一头暴怒的雄狮，浑身气浪翻滚。
“林昊，你这是公报私仇，我儿犯了什么罪，要坐地牢，即便如今你是圣子，也要奖罚分明，太玄宗是讲道理的地方。”
李开先站在林昊面前，恨不得一巴掌将其拍死，但他也很清楚，在西门先生面前，就算他想出手，也没有半点机会。
李开先想到了林昊会报复他们父子，事实上，太玄宗所有人都能想得到，只是没想到林昊的报复来得如此快，如此直接。
“急了！”
林昊嗤笑一声：“李开先，你现在跟我讲道理，可惜，道理不在你手中，我是圣子，我就是道理。”
李开先气歇。
“你什么你，滚一边去，不要耽误本圣子执法。”
林昊没好气的说道，他看见李开先就烦，老不死的狗东西，现在知道急了，刚才要执法把自己当场处死的时候，可比这嚣张跋扈多了。
若非李开先是化元境长老，林昊连他一并收拾掉。
先收拾他儿子，回头再慢慢收拾老子。
这对父子都要死，从最开始就蓄谋要自己的命，现在攻守易型了。
广场上，执法堂弟子已经将李晴川按住，准备押送地牢。
“爹，救我。”
李晴川慌了，他们父子向来在太玄宗嚣张跋扈，一手遮天，不久之前更是攀上了凌家高枝，甚至还暗中拿了凌家的好处，设计把林昊弄到太玄宗来。
可惜局势变了，请来了一个瘟神，搬石头砸自己脚。
见林昊玩真的，李开先如热锅上的蚂蚁，地牢是什么地方他最是清楚，即便李晴川是气海境七重的修为，在地牢内也撑不过五天，不死也得残废。
“圣女，西门先生，请你们做主。”
李开先对着易扶摇和西门先生躬身：“圣子无视宗门法度，以自身权利公报私仇，如何能服众。”
“不对吧，老夫刚才可是亲眼看到李晴川拎着剑追砍圣子，如此以下犯上，押送地牢，也合情合理吧。”
任百川呵呵一笑。
“放屁，任百川，你不要颠倒是非，适才林昊还不是圣子。”
李开先张牙舞爪。
“可他现在是圣子。”
任百川耸了耸肩。
李开先想吐血，玛德，明着不讲理了是吧。
“西门长老，请您主持公道。”
李开先来到西门先生面前。
西门先生一脸的慈祥，笑呵呵地看着李开先：“凡事有因才有果，我相信圣子如此做，自有他的原因，开先啊，看开点，押送地牢，又不是处死，我给你说个情，送地牢三天就行了。”
李开先一愣，差点没当场暴走。
这叫啥话，什么叫又不是处死？
什么叫送地牢三天就行了，送地牢三天他妈的就死了。
content_en:
A real man never wrongs himself. When he has the ability to take revenge, he should not hesitate to use the most practical means to kill his opponent.
Cultivation is not easy. If you can blame others, don’t blame yourself.
Longmenshan Square was instantly in chaos. The disciples around Li Qingchuan retreated like a tide. Those disciples who had a better relationship with Li Qingchuan before retreated the farthest and wanted to draw a clear line with Li Qingchuan.
This is what is called a friend with benefits.
When you are brilliant, they will be by your side and at your disposal, and you will be your master.
When you are in decline, you will be the target of public criticism, and they will avoid you. Those who hide far away are considered conscientious. If there is a chance, they will be the first to step on you.
Five or six law enforcement hall disciples came out first and wanted to attack Li Qingchuan.
"Stop."
Li Kaixian shouted loudly, and his eyes were about to split, like a furious lion, with waves of energy rolling all over his body.
"Lin Hao, you are avenging a private vendetta. What crime did my son commit? He will go to the dungeon. Even if you are the Holy Son now, rewards and punishments must be clear. Taixuanzong is a place of reason."
Li Kaixian stood in front of Lin Hao, wanting to slap him to death, but he also knew very well that in front of Mr. Ximen, even if he wanted to make a move, he had no chance.
Li Kaixian thought that Lin Hao would take revenge on their father and son. In fact, everyone in Taixuan Sect could think of it, but he didn't expect Lin Hao's revenge to come so quickly and directly.
"Urgent!"
Lin Hao sneered: "Li Kaixian, you are trying to reason with me now. Unfortunately, the truth is not in your hands. I am the Holy Son, and I am the truth."
"You..."
Li Kai first took a breath.
"What are you doing? Get out of here and don't delay this Holy Son's law enforcement."
Lin Hao said angrily. He was annoyed when he saw Li Kaixian. He was an old and immortal bitch. Now he knows that he is anxious. When he wanted to be executed on the spot by law enforcement, he was much more arrogant and domineering than this.
If Li Kaixian hadn't been an elder in Huayuan Realm, Lin Hao would have dealt with him as well.
Take care of his son first, then slowly take care of me later.
Both father and son are going to die. They have been plotting to take their own lives from the very beginning, and now they have changed their stance on offense and defense.
In the square, the disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall had already held Li Qingchuan down and were preparing to escort him to the dungeon.
"Dad, save me."
Li Qingchuan panicked. Their father and son had always been arrogant and domineering in Taixuanzong, and they had climbed up to the top of the Ling family not long ago. They even secretly took advantage of the Ling family and designed to get Lin Hao to come to Taixuanzong.
It's a pity that the situation has changed, and a plague god was invited to shoot himself in the foot.
Seeing Lin Hao's seriousness, Li Kaixian was like an ant on a hot pot. He knew the dungeon best. Even if Li Qingchuan was at the seventh level of Qi Sea Realm, he would not be able to survive five days in the dungeon, and he would be disabled if he did not die.
"Holy girl, Mr. Simon, please make the decision."
Li Kaixian bowed to Yi Fuyao and Mr. Ximen: "The Holy Son ignores the sect's laws and uses his own rights to avenge his private revenge. How can he convince the public?"
"No, I just saw with my own eyes Li Qingchuan chasing the Holy Son with a sword. It is reasonable for him to be escorted to the dungeon for such a crime."
Ren Baichuan chuckled.
"Fart, Ren Baichuan, don't confuse right and wrong. Just now, Lin Hao was not the Holy Son."
Li Kai first bared his teeth and claws.
"But he is the Holy Son now."
Ren Baichuan shrugged.
Li Kaixian wanted to vomit blood, Ma De, it was obvious that he was being unreasonable, right?
"Elder Ximen, please seek justice."
Li Kaixian came to Mr. Ximen.
Mr. Ximen looked at Li Kaixian with a kind face and smiled: "Everything has a cause and an effect. I believe that the Holy Son has his own reasons for doing this. Kai Xian, look at it. He is escorted to the dungeon, not executed. I will give you a pity and just send him to the dungeon for three days."
Li Kaixian was stunned and almost ran away on the spot.
What does this mean? What does it mean but it is not execution?
What do you mean, just send him to the dungeon for three days and it will be fine. If he is sent to the dungeon for three days, he will die.
title_en: Chapter 15: Walk slowly on the road to Huangquan Chapter 16: Li Kaixian’s revenge
